title: Kagurabachi Studio’s Stunning Summer 2026 Anime Confirms Release Date With New Trailer
content: 2026 is going to be yet another exciting year for anime fans, with several thrilling series returning with their sequels on top of major debuts. January is almost over, and the first month of the year has already proved it.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Series Creator Unveils New Look At Beloved Character Ahead of Anime Sequel
content: Kusanagi Mizuho’s beloved fantasy shojo manga, Yona of the Dawn , reached its conclusion on December 19th, 2025, after a 16-year-long journey. The historical manga debuted in 2009 on a monthly schedule, earning praise for its gorgeous art, unique storytelling, and lovable characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Is All Set For Its Anticipated Final Release
content: The hit Jujutsu Kaisen manga, written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, ended serialization in September 2024. It wasn’t until December 25th of the same year that Shueisha released Volumes 29 and 30, marking the end of the incredible story.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 Anime Masterpieces That Are Under 30 Episodes
content: Many anime masterpieces take time to achieve that status, which results in lengthier runs — but there are some standouts that are under 30 episodes. This makes them ideal for binge-watching, especially for anyone looking for anime to watch in a single weekend .
